## Dough Intent Coverage

**Verdict. Caught.**

**Story and revision.** SEED-423#use-one-managed-install-layout at `8d3306fd9bc98246daa01a0a2e1d496b31ed3ce3`. The checked promise is that Claude runtime resolution refuses with the expected `.claude` entry point when that file is missing and the `.agents` entry point is available.

**Fault and witness.** In an isolated checkout, I changed `resolveCheckoutRuntime` in `Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/ci-checkout-runtime.mjs` to fall back to `.agents` when Claude's entry point was missing. A separate witness copied the mailbox entry point into a temporary `.agents` root, verified the absence of the `.claude` entry point, and observed Claude resolution returning the installed `.agents` entry point.

**Maintained check.** I ran `caffeinate -s -i /opt/homebrew/bin/bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/skills/dough-execute-plan/ci-deployment-layout.test.mjs` with Homebrew Bash on PATH and one worker. The baseline passed. On the faulted run, the `assert.throws` at line 147 in “a missing host runtime names its entry point and refuses setup” failed with “Missing expected exception.” The test fixture installs `.agents` only and expects the exact missing `.claude` path. The restored run passed. The runtime file matched its original bytes, Git status matched the clean baseline, and I removed the scratch worktree. The runner outcomes, fault, and witness are in `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-seed-423.ctz5WNir/`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the current assertion for this path. This probe identified no need for stronger proof on the tested refusal.
